object: Flat bracket or mounting plate with a central hole and a row of mounting slots

views.constrains: Overall height (Z) and width (X). Shows the object as a thin vertical rectangle.
Overall width (X) and depth (Y). Shows the complex profile including the central circular hole and the wavy/scalloped edges at the top and bottom.
Overall depth (Y) and height (Z). Shows the row of 5 rectangular slots running vertically.

parts.name: Main Plate
parts.description: A flat, rectangular plate with a specific width, height, and thickness.

features.description: A circular through-hole located centrally in the width and depth, positioned near the top (visible in top view).
A vertical row of 5 rectangular slots (or holes) running down the center of the object's height.
The top edge has a concave (inward) curve or notch.
The bottom edge has a wavy or scalloped profile.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: The exact thickness of the plate is not explicitly dimensioned but is inferred from the narrow width of the front view.
The exact shape of the 'wavy' bottom edge in the top view is interpreted as a decorative or functional scallop.
The slots in the right view are interpreted as through-cuts based on the 'flat plate' nature of the object.
interpretation_conflicts: The right view shows slots, while the top view shows a central hole. These are distinct features at different locations along the height (Z-axis). The top view corresponds to the top section of the object (containing the hole), while the right view shows the full height including the slots below.
generation_notes: The object is a flat plate. The construction starts with the profile defined in the Top View (XY plane) and extrudes it along the Z-axis (Height) to match the Front and Right views. The slots seen in the Right view are cut through the thickness (Y-axis) of the plate.

parameters.description: Extrude the profile to the full height of the object.
A circular through-hole located centrally in the width and depth, positioned near the top (visible in top view).
A vertical row of 5 rectangular slots (or holes) running down the center of the object's height.

unresolved_constraints: Exact dimensions of the slots relative to the plate width.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
